svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Data and model lifecycle
svg.desc: Data and model lifecycle. 12 components in 3 groups. Connections: Weekly GitHub Actions job to LeetCode GraphQL (contest histories); update_data.py to export_dataset.py (data/data.json); export_dataset.py to Dataset repo (Parquet); backtest.py to Backtest PR (docs/backtest.md); Dataset repo to train.py (--data hub); train.py to export_model.py (model.keras); export_model.py to Model artifacts (models/); Model artifacts to FastAPI on Render (committed if it wins); Model artifacts to Model repo (publish_model.py); Model repo to Chrome extension (model.json).

text.tspan: A weekly job publishes the data to the Hub; retraining is manual and ships only if it wins the backtest
